articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
articles.summary: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
articles.summaryTr: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.
articles.articleText: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended. Crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin will resume deposits and withdrawals in Brazilian reais via Pix, the country’s instant payment system, next week, a company representative told Cointelegraph. The restart will come more than 15 days after an attack drained an estimated $49 million from wallets linked to the exchange. Customers will only be able to withdraw funds to accounts in their own name. Mercado Bitcoin will also credit customers’ accounts with proceeds from the settlement of fixed income products. Crypto deposits and withdrawals remain suspended, with no date set for their return. Mercado Bitcoin, one of Brazil’s largest crypto exchanges, began restoring access on Monday, a week after the attack, by allowing customers to view their accounts in read-only mode. Customers who regain access are directed to a page detailing the exchange’s security measures and regular audits since 2018, with a link to a separate account of the incident. Fabricio Tota, Mercado Bitcoin’s vice president of new business, outlined the next phase in a recent video. The exchange has yet to publish a rollout schedule on its website. “The resumption will proceed gradually, and the rollout of additional services will be communicated to clients in advance through MB’s official channels,” the representative said. The Nov. 2 attack on Mercado Bitcoin came four days after hackers stole about $6.3 billion in crypto from Binance’s hot wallets in a separate breach. The FBI attributed the Binance theft to North Korean hackers. The crypto exchange said it would cover the losses using its emergency fund and corporate treasury. Magazine: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express

articles.title: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned
articles.summary: The ruling brings to an end an 11-year legal battle by dual-citizen Jason Jones.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned
articles.summaryTr: The ruling brings to an end an 11-year legal battle by dual-citizen Jason Jones.
articles.articleText: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned - Published A UK court has overturned laws criminalising same-sex intimacy in Trinidad and Tobago. London's Judicial Committee of the Privy Council (JCPC), the Caribbean island's final court of appeal, ruled the laws were not in keeping with the "fundamental individual right to respect for private and family life." The judgement is the result of an 11-year legal battle brought by dual-citizen Jason Jones, 62, who said he hoped it would "accelerate the fight for full equality." Jones had successfully challenged the laws in 2018 in Trinidad's High Court, however the ruling was overturned on appeal by the Trinidadian government. It is the first time the JCPC has ever decided on a case to decriminalise same-sex intimacy, and campaigners hope it will spark similar successful legal challenges elsewhere in the Commonwealth. Prior to this historic decision, Trinidad and Tobago was one of some 34 Commonwealth countries continuing to criminalise homosexuality based on colonial-era British laws. Under these laws, consensual same-sex intimacy is punishable by imprisonment, and in some cases carries the death penalty. The Attorney General of Trinidad and Tobago had argued that the law was protected from legal challenges by the "savings law clauses" - which carried over existing British laws into newly independent states. Representatives for Jones argued that the laws violated an individual's right to privacy and argued the government's changes to the laws in 1986 - which saw stricter punishments introduced - meant the savings clause protections no longer applied. The judicial committee unanimously found in favour of Jones. Handing down the judgement, Lord Sales told the court the laws "cannot be regarded as reasonably justifiable in a society that has a proper respect for the rights and freedoms of an individual". Jones, human rights campaigner and appellant in the appeal, said: "These laws never reflected who we are as a people and a nation - diverse, multiracial, and secular. "They told LGBTQ+ people that we were criminals in our own country. That message ends today." Lawyer Anand Ramlogan SC, representing Jones, said the judgement was a "landmark victory for gay rights, equal dignity and respect for private and family life in Trinidad and Tobago." Related topics - Published23 April 2024 - Published1 January 2020

articles.title: US federal authorities could have prevented Epstein crimes, report finds
articles.summary: The report by a Republican-led congressional committee follows a 15-month investigation into the handling of the late disgraced financier's case.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: US federal authorities could have prevented Epstein crimes, report finds
articles.summaryTr: The report by a Republican-led congressional committee follows a 15-month investigation into the handling of the late disgraced financier's case.
articles.articleText: US federal authorities could have prevented Epstein crimes, report finds - Published Crimes committed by the late disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein after 2005 could have been prevented were it not for "failures" by federal investigators and prosecutors, a congressional investigation has concluded. The Republican-led US House Oversight Committee on Tuesday released its final report into what it described as the "decades-long" mishandling of the criminal investigations into Epstein and his long-term associate Ghislaine Maxwell. The report's findings are based on interviews and depositions with witnesses, government files, and financial records over a 15-month period. Epstein died in 2019 as he awaited trial on sex trafficking charges. "While some of these failures involved an exercise in poor judgement by the USAO, others appeared to be the result of Epstein's pervasive and wide-reaching influence," the report reads, referring to the US Attorney's Office. It states that, rather than fully investigating allegations in other states, the USAO for the Southern District of Florida entered an agreement with Epstein in 2007 allowing him to evade federal prosecution. Regarding Epstein's death in a New York prison, investigators concluded this was a result of "a series of institutional failures at the facility," which included staffing shortages, overworked employees, poor recordkeeping, and lax security practices. Testimony the panel solicited was "unable to definitively dispel certain theories" surrounding Epstein's death, the report states, including accounting for a lapse in surveillance footage. It found the justice department (DoJ) failed to communicate about document releases and that deficient redactions exposed survivors' sensitive personal information. Earlier this year, the DoJ had to remove thousands of documents related to Epstein from its website after victims said their identities had been compromised. The report also alleges that financial institutions like American Express enabled human trafficking and immigration fraud, by allowing Epstein to use decoy flights and dummy itineraries to transport foreign workers across borders. The BBC has contacted American Express for comment. The investigative panel recommended that Congress should pass legislation to prevent the weaponisation of non-disclosure agreements, which they said Epstein used to silence survivors. "Epstein operated with impunity, shielded and enabled by powerful connections and a justice system that repeatedly failed his victims," said James Comer, the Republican chairman of the committee. He called upon the DoJ to "interview or re-interview key witnesses, investigate Epstein associates accused of criminal activity, and ensure survivors have access to their records. The report accuses Democrats of being "obsessed" with trying to implicate US President Donald Trump and that an "unfounded witch hunt continued without regard for the interests of survivors". Trump has previously said he was friendly with Epstein before they fell out in 2004. The president's name has appeared thousands of times in the Epstein files but there is no suggestion that appearing in the documents implies any wrongdoing. The committee's review of documents did not identify any that would implicate Trump, the report concluded. In a statement, Rep Robert Garcia, the top Democrat on the Oversight Committee, alleged his Republican colleagues "released a report based on an incomplete investigation and zero public hearings on Jeffrey Epstein". Garcia accused the justice department of withholding "over 2.5 million pages of documents". "We will not allow the President and his allies to dismiss this investigation," said Garcia, who is expected to lead the committee when Democrats take control of Congress in January following the recent midterm elections. - Published23 April

articles.title: Anthropic set for $1.3tn stock market debut despite 'catastrophic' AI warning
articles.summary: The AI company behind the Claude chatbot will offer its shares at between $70 and $78, which is lower than what was expected.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Anthropic set for $1.3tn stock market debut despite 'catastrophic' AI warning
articles.summaryTr: The AI company behind the Claude chatbot will offer its shares at between $70 and $78, which is lower than what was expected.
articles.articleText: Anthropic set for $1.3tn stock market debut despite 'catastrophic' AI warning - Published Anthropic, the artificial intelligence (AI) company behind the Claude chatbot, could be valued at around $1.3 trillion (£1 trillion) when it lists its shares for sale on New York's Nasdaq stock exchange. The loss-making company says it will offer its shares for between $70 and $78 each and will raise up to $64bn when it floats this month. It would value Anthropic at between $1.1tn and $1.3tn which, although large, is below the $2tn some backers of the firm predicted in summer, according to the Financial Times. The huge valuation comes despite the company warning last month that AI could pose "catastrophic or existential risks to humanity". It is floating at a volatile time for big tech firms. After last week's US midterm elections, the Nasdaq fell sharply on concerns a Democrat-led Congress could slow development of AI and the buildout of data centres. There are also wider fears over the billions of dollars being spent on AI and whether it will pay off. In its most recent results for the six months to the end of June, Anthropic's revenues jumped to $16.2bn from $1.1bn in the same period last year. However, its pre-tax loss jumped to $80.7bn from $12.9bn. Fiona Cincotta, a senior market analyst at City Index, said the $64bn Anthropic wants to raise is "fairly bullish" within "the volatility [and] concerns towards AI that we've seen in sort of particularly last week". She told Reuters: "It's showing that they are still sort of upbeat about the outlook as far as AI is concerned and that obviously that they think that the demand is going to be there." Anthropic, which will list under the symbol ANT on 19 November, will be the first fully AI-focused company to go public, making it a test case for the future of the technology. At $1.3tn, Anthropic's possible valuation is below SpaceX, Elon Musk's rocket, satellite and artificial intelligence company, which listed its shares in June and was valued at nearly $1.8tn. - Global stocks plunge as fears over US AI slowdown spread to Asia and Europe - Published4 days ago - Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know - Published26 October Anthropic is just five years old. It was co-founded in 2021 by brother and sister Dario and Daniela Amodei along with five others – all of whom worked at OpenAI, the rival AI giant behind ChatGPT. It announced its intention to list on the stock market in June and OpenAI followed suit. That listing is now expected to occur early next year. The listing announcements were followed by a series of incidents involving AI agents, which are bots designed to operate somewhat autonomously, going rogue. Current and former staff of both companies have warned AI technology was being developed without the ability to protect humanity from possible future harms enacted by AI. Anthropic has admitted that advanced AI systems "could, if not developed, deployed, and operated with appropriate safeguards, oversight, and security measures, pose catastrophic or existential risks to humanity, particularly if such systems were misused, replicated, weaponised, or allowed to operate with a high degree of autonomy". The company has reiterated promises to develop AI to be beneficial to people. It has warned investors its future success depends largely on its ability to develop the most advanced AI models, and that "any failure to do so could adversely affect our business".

Anthropic has admitted that advanced AI systems "could, if not developed, deployed, and operated with appropriate safeguards, oversight, and security measures, pose catastrophic or existential risks to humanity, particularly if such systems were misused, replicated, weaponised, or allowed to operate with a high degree of autonomy". The company has reiterated promises to develop AI to be beneficial to people. It has warned investors its future success depends largely on its ability to develop the most advanced AI models, and that "any failure to do so could adversely affect our business".

articles.articleText: Tüm hisseler devredildi: İki kamu bankası TVF çatısı altında buluştu - Türkiye Varlık Fonu, Ziraat Katılım ve Halk Katılım bankalarının tüm hisselerini TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları AŞ'ye devretti. İşlemlerin tamamlanmasıyla iki kamu sermayeli katılım bankası aynı çatı altında toplandı. Türkiye Varlık Fonu (TVF), Ziraat Katılım ve Halk Katılım bankalarının paylarının tamamının TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları AŞ'ye devredildiğini duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle TVF'nin internet sitesinden yapılan açıklamaya göre, 7 Ekim 2026 tarihinde duyurulan pay devir sözleşmeleri kapsamında ilgili yasal ve düzenleyici süreçler tamamlandı. Devir işlemlerinin kapanışı da gerçekleştirildi. Kamu sermayeli katılım bankaları tek çatı altında Devir işlemiyle kamu sermayeli katılım finans kurumlarının aynı çatı altında toplanmasına yönelik süreçte önemli bir aşama tamamlanmış oldu. Düzenlemeyle katılım finans kurumlarının kapasitesinin ve rekabet gücünün artırılması, finansal piyasalar içerisindeki paylarının büyütülmesi hedefleniyor. TVF'den katılım finans ekosistemi vurgusu Türkiye Varlık Fonu, yatırım stratejisi doğrultusunda finansal piyasaların derinleşmesine ve katılım finans ekosisteminin gelişmesine katkı sağlamaya yönelik çalışmalarını sürdüreceğini bildirdi.

articles.title: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
articles.summary: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
articles.summaryTr: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.
articles.articleText: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors. Crypto industry experts warned on Tuesday that higher-than-expected US inflation could lead to a another Federal Reserve interest rate hike, making borrowing more expensive and potentially discouraging investment in cryptocurrencies. The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.4% month over month in October, above economists’ forecast of 0.3%, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics - a slower increase than September’s 0.6% rise. Core inflation, which excludes food and energy prices, rose 0.3%, above the expected 0.2%. Currently, the Federal Reserve holds its benchmark interest rate at 3.75% to 4.00%, after raising it by a quarter-point in September and leaving it unchanged in October. The report came just a few hours after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said in London that another core inflation reading of 0.3% or higher could prompt the Fed to consider a larger interest rate hike in December. “In that case, I believe a 50-basis-point hike in the policy rate should be considered at the December meeting,” Waller said. “Hiking only 25-basis-points would put our credibility at risk, a risk I am not eager to take.” Markets were already pricing a quarter-point Fed hike in December. Tuesday’s data and Waller’s remarks are now raising the odds that the Fed would tighten monetary policy more aggressively in December, potentially raising borrowing costs and squeezing returns for leveraged crypto investors. Related: US midterm elections 2026 as it happened: Democrats win control of Congress Crypto experts warn of higher borrowing costs After the CPI release, traders were pricing in slightly more than a quarter point of Fed tightening for December, according to Jeff Anderson, head of US at crypto trading firm STS Digital. “Following today’s CPI release, markets are now pricing approximately 27 basis points of tightening into the December rate curve,” Anderson said in comments shared with Cointelegraph. “The prospect of another rate hike is becoming increasingly difficult to ignore.” CME FedWatch data as of 16:28 UTC on Tuesday showed an 88.3% chance of a quarter-point rate hike in December and an 11.7% chance of a half-point increase. Meanwhile, the broader crypto market was trading lower following the report, with total market capitalization falling 1.6% over the past 24 hours to $2.57 trillion, according to CoinGecko. Bitcoin (BTC) traded near $73,274, down 2% over the past 24 hours, while Ether (ETH) fell nearly 5% to around $2,028 and Solana (SOL) dropped 5.6% to $82. Experts said that higher interest rates could also reduce profits from some crypto investments. Adam Haeems, head of asset management at Tesseract Group, told Cointelegraph that investors who borrow money to make other investments could earn less if borrowing becomes more expensive. “Carry strategies earn the gap between what their assets yield and what they pay to borrow, so they are squeezed when borrowing costs rise relative to that yield,” Haeems said. “Over the past two weeks the rate paid to USDC lenders on Aave’s main market ranged from about 3.2% to 7%, while three-month Treasury yields stayed close to 4.2%.” The difference, in turn, could influence where investors put their money, especially if traditional investments offer better returns with less risk. Inflation adds to pressure after US midterms The inflation report also came a week after the US midterm elections, in which Democrats won control of both the House and Senate. “There is also likely to be growing political pressure from a blue Congress to bring inflation under control, potentially reinforcing the case for higher rates,” Anderson said. Still, he added that he remained skeptical about whether further rate hikes would address the underlying causes of inflation. While Congress does not set interest rates, lawmakers can influence economic policy and crypto regulation. For instance, the CLARITY Act, a bill aimed at creating clearer crypto rules for the US, has been stalled since January amid disagreements between Democrats and Republicans. The shift in congressional power combined with the possibility of higher borrowing costs could create even more uncertainty for crypto investors, experts said. Magazine: Wall Street killed Bitcoin’s wild rallies: 10x’s Markus Thielen

articles.title: First day of Ukraine peace talks constructive, Zelensky says
articles.summary: Delegations from Kyiv, Washington and Moscow are in the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: First day of Ukraine peace talks constructive, Zelensky says
articles.summaryTr: Delegations from Kyiv, Washington and Moscow are in the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.
articles.articleText: First day of Ukraine peace talks constructive, Zelensky says - Published The first of two days of trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia and the US aimed at ending the war in Ukraine has concluded in Abu Dhabi. While senior officials from Kyiv and Moscow were tight-lipped after the four hour-long discussions, President Volodymyr Zelensky, who was not at the talks, said they had proved "constructive and quite substantive". Speaking from Paris, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio also said the meeting had been "very productive". Although expectations for a breakthrough that ends Russia's full-scale war on Ukraine are low, US officials said earlier that Moscow and Kyiv were privately showing "a little bit of flexibility" on the issue of who would control Ukraine's eastern regions in a postwar scenario. Zelensky also said that humanitarian issues such as prisoner of war exchanges had been discussed. At the start of Tuesday's talks President Donald Trump's son-in-law, Jared Kushner, told delegates that the US had "narrowed the gaps" between the two sides, without providing details, and hoped to move towards a "solution that hopefully ends the war". Kushner had said earlier the talks would be focused on addressing the "postwar security concerns" of both Russia and Ukraine. He and Trump peace envoy Steve Witkoff also met Ukrainian and European and Nato officials on the sidelines of the main meeting. Until now European leaders have largely been excluded from peace talks, but they have pushed to be included in the discussions amid concerns that decisions about their continent's security would be made without them. The Americans appear to support this, with Rubio acknowledging during a visit to Paris that the Europeans "are a part of solving this problem for the long term". However, "the Russians have a bad taste in their mouth with the Europeans", according to a US official. Some proposals favoured by EU officials - such as calling an unconditional ceasefire as a prerequisite for peace negotiations - are routinely rejected by Moscow. Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said on Tuesday that a truce would just allow Kyiv to regroup. "We will not agree to it," he said. Moscow and Kyiv's positions are still far apart on ending the conflict. A key area of disagreement involves Ukraine's eastern region of Donetsk, which is mostly occupied by Russia. Moscow has demanded that Ukraine relinquish the parts of Donetsk it still holds, while Kyiv wants to freeze the contact line to maintain control over those areas, which it says are crucial to its future security. While neither side has budged on these demands, the US official speaking on the eve of the talks suggested that this was just the public stance and that Moscow and Kyiv had shown "a little bit of flexibility, privately". However, he acknowledged the issue would not be solved without discussions about a new "security architecture". "They will not solve the Donetsk issue and the territorial issue until they know what the security architecture is going to be after the war," the official said. "And keep in mind, we're not going to be able to finalise one without the other." For Ukraine, a post-war "security architecture" may include reassurance that allies will come to its aid if it comes under attack again. For Russia, that could be its longstanding ambition to see Nato roll back from Eastern Europe – which would be alarming to Europeans. The framework being proposed includes security consultations and crisis communications hotlines, as well as "reciprocal de-escalation measures" between the two. The officials also floated the re-activation of the Nato-Russia Council that has been largely paused since 2022. The last round of trilateral talks, held in Geneva in February, ended without a breakthrough. Soon after, the US-Israel war on Iran diverted Washington's attention from Ukraine, and no other discussions were held since. From the start of his second term in office, US President Donald Trump – who once boasted he could end the war in Ukraine within a day – has spearheaded several rounds of talks to end the conflict, albeit with little success. Meanwhile, his increasingly conciliatory approach towards Moscow has fuelled deep unease in Kyiv and across the European Union. After meeting Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev in Washington last week, Trump touted a forthcoming "big, beautiful agreement" on Ukraine that "might involve all of Europe". Many in Ukraine are sceptical that this would result in a fair peace. Ukrainian MP Oleksandr Merezhko, head of the foreign affairs parliamentary committee, told the BBC he believed Trump wanted "a quick deal at the expense of Ukraine", which will certainly be rejected by Kyiv. The only way to make Russia's Vladimir Putin start real negotiations was by putting greater pressure on Russia through sanctions and deep strikes, Merezhko said. "While Putin has a war machine up and running, he has no incentives to negotiate." He also mentioned recent moves by Trump, such as his deal to buy diesel from Russia, as something that "only encourages Moscow to continue the war". Moscow's delegation in Abu Dhabi includes Kremlin aide Vladimir Medinsky, deputy foreign ministers Sergei Ryabkov and Mikhail Galuzin, spy chief Igor Kostyukov and army general Yury Zhigarlovsky. Kyiv has sent several senior officials who have been part of previous negotiating teams, including Foreign Intelligence Service head Rustem Umerov, Volodymyr Zelensky's chief of staff Kyrylo Budanov, and MP Davyd Arakhamiya. Away from Abu Dhabi, Russia continues to pummel Ukraine with deadly bombardments and strikes on energy infrastructure, viewed in Kyiv as proof that Moscow wants to corner Ukraine into accepting a deal on Russia's terms. On Monday, Kushner was cautious to point out that the Abu Dhabi talks could at most "build momentum toward the next phase of negotiations". "This is an extraordinarily difficult and complicated conflict," he wrote on X, adding the US was "approaching these discussions with determination and realism." Moscow has demanded that Ukraine relinquish the parts of Donetsk it still holds, while Kyiv wants to freeze the contact line to maintain control over those areas, which it says are crucial to its future security. While neither side has budged on these demands, the US official speaking on the eve of the talks suggested that this was just the public stance and that Moscow and Kyiv had shown "a little bit of flexibility, privately". However, he acknowledged the issue would not be solved without discussions about a new "security architecture". "They will not solve the Donetsk issue and the territorial issue until they know what the security architecture is going to be after the war," the official said. "And keep in mind, we're not going to be able to finalise one without the other." For Ukraine, a post-war "security architecture" may include reassurance that allies will come to its aid if it comes under attack again. For Russia, that could be its longstanding ambition to see Nato roll back from Eastern Europe – which would be alarming to Europeans. The framework being proposed includes security consultations and crisis communications hotlines, as well as "reciprocal de-escalation measures" between the two. The officials also floated the re-activation of the Nato-Russia Council that has been largely paused since 2022. The last round of trilateral talks, held in Geneva in February, ended without a breakthrough. Soon after, the US-Israel war on Iran diverted Washington's attention from Ukraine, and no other discussions were held since. From the start of his second term in office, US President Donald Trump – who once boasted he could end the war in Ukraine within a day – has spearheaded several rounds of talks to end the conflict, albeit with little success. Meanwhile, his increasingly conciliatory approach towards Moscow has fuelled deep unease in Kyiv and across the European Union. After meeting Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev in Washington last week, Trump touted a forthcoming "big, beautiful agreement" on Ukraine that "might involve all of Europe". Many in Ukraine are sceptical that this would result in a fair peace. Ukrainian MP Oleksandr Merezhko, head of the foreign affairs parliamentary committee, told the BBC he believed Trump wanted "a quick deal at the expense of Ukraine", which will certainly be rejected by Kyiv. The only way to make Russia's Vladimir Putin start real negotiations was by putting greater pressure on Russia through sanctions and deep strikes, Merezhko said. "While Putin has a war machine up and running, he has no incentives to negotiate." He also mentioned recent moves by Trump, such as his deal to buy diesel from Russia, as something that "only encourages Moscow to continue the war". Moscow's delegation in Abu Dhabi includes Kremlin aide Vladimir Medinsky, deputy foreign ministers Sergei Ryabkov and Mikhail Galuzin, spy chief Igor Kostyukov and army general Yury Zhigarlovsky. Kyiv has sent several senior officials who have been part of previous negotiating teams, including Foreign Intelligence Service head Rustem Umerov, Volodymyr Zelensky's chief of staff Kyrylo Budanov, and MP Davyd Arakhamiya. Away from Abu Dhabi, Russia continues to pummel Ukraine with deadly bombardments and strikes on energy infrastructure, viewed in Kyiv as proof that Moscow wants to corner Ukraine into accepting a deal on Russia's terms. On Monday, Kushner was cautious to point out that the Abu Dhabi talks could at most "build momentum toward the next phase of negotiations". "This is an extraordinarily difficult and complicated conflict," he wrote on X, adding the US was "approaching these discussions with determination and realism." articles.articleText: Yapı Kredi'den (YKBNK) 933 milyon dolarlık dev sendikasyon kredisi! İşte detaylar - Yapı Kredi, uluslararası piyasalardan yaklaşık 933 milyon dolar tutarında sendikasyon kredisi sağladı. 18 ülkeden 40 finansal kurumun katıldığı anlaşma, 367 ve 734 gün vadeli dört ayrı dilimden oluştu. Yapı ve Kredi Bankası, yılın ikinci yarısında uluslararası piyasalardan yaklaşık 933 milyon dolar tutarında sendikasyon kredisi sağladı. Bankadan yapılan açıklamaya göre anlaşmaya 18 ülkeden 40 finansal kurum katıldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 367 ve 734 gün vadeli dört ayrı dilimden oluşan kredinin ortak koordinatörlüğünü Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank, Bank of America, Emirates NBD ve Standard Chartered üstlendi. İşlemin aracılığını ise Emirates NBD gerçekleştirdi. Kredinin detayları belli oldu Sendikasyon kredisi kapsamında 367 gün vadeli 349 milyon dolar ve 356,5 milyon avro, 734 gün vadeli ise 97 milyon dolar ve 77 milyon avro finansman sağlandı. Kredinin maliyeti vade ve para birimine göre farklılık gösterdi. Buna göre 367 gün vadeli dilimlerde dolar için SOFR + yüzde 1,25, avro için Euribor + yüzde 1,00 maliyet belirlendi. 734 gün vadeli dilimlerde ise dolar maliyeti SOFR + yüzde 1,75, avro maliyeti Euribor + yüzde 1,45 oldu. Erün: Türkiye ekonomisine duyulan güvenin göstergesi Yapı Kredi Üst Yöneticisi (CEO) Gökhan Erün, uluslararası piyasalardan sağlanan kaynağın bankanın finansal yapısına ve Türkiye ekonomisine duyulan güveni gösterdiğini belirtti. Erün, yaklaşık 933 milyon dolarlık işlemin uluslararası finans kuruluşlarıyla kurulan uzun soluklu ilişkilerin bir yansıması olduğunu ifade etti. Uluslararası kuruluşların ilgisinin arkasında bankanın sağlam bilanço yapısı, etkin risk yönetimi ve sürdürülebilir büyüme anlayışının bulunduğunu vurgulayan Erün, gelecek dönemde kaynak çeşitliliğini artırmaya ve reel sektörün finansman ihtiyaçlarını desteklemeye devam edeceklerini kaydetti.

articles.title: Borsa İstanbul’da 7 şirketten KAP açıklaması: Milyarlık anlaşmalar ve yeni yatırımlar
articles.summary: Borsa İstanbul'da 7 şirketten yeni iş, yatırım ve finansman açıklaması geldi. Yapı Kredi 933 milyon dolarlık kredi sağlarken, Aksa Enerji Gabon'da kapasite artırdı. Kardemir Çelik GES kredisi aldı, Halkbank 14,8 milyar TL'lik devri tamamladı.

articles.titleTr: Borsa İstanbul’da 7 şirketten KAP açıklaması: Milyarlık anlaşmalar ve yeni yatırımlar
articles.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul'da 7 şirketten yeni iş, yatırım ve finansman açıklaması geldi. Yapı Kredi 933 milyon dolarlık kredi sağlarken, Aksa Enerji Gabon'da kapasite artırdı. Kardemir Çelik GES kredisi aldı, Halkbank 14,8 milyar TL'lik devri tamamladı.
articles.articleText: Borsa İstanbul’da 7 şirketten KAP açıklaması: Milyarlık anlaşmalar ve yeni yatırımlar Borsa İstanbul'da 7 şirketten yeni iş, yatırım ve finansman açıklaması geldi. Yapı Kredi 933 milyon dolarlık kredi sağlarken, Aksa Enerji Gabon'da kapasite artırdı. Kardemir Çelik GES kredisi aldı, Halkbank 14,8 milyar TL'lik devri tamamladı. YAPI KREDİ'DEN 933 MİLYON DOLARLIK SENDİKASYON KREDİSİ Yapı ve Kredi Bankası (YKBNK), 18 ülkeden 40 finansal kurumun katılımıyla yaklaşık 933 milyon dolar tutarında sendikasyon kredisi anlaşması imzaladı. Dört ayrı dilimden oluşan kredinin 367 gün vadeli kısmında 349 milyon dolar ve 356,5 milyon avro, 734 gün vadeli kısmında ise 97 milyon dolar ve 77 milyon avro finansman sağlandı. 367 gün vadeli dolar ve avro dilimlerinin maliyeti sırasıyla SOFR + yüzde 1,25 ve Euribor + yüzde 1 olurken, 734 gün vadeli dilimlerde maliyet SOFR + yüzde 1,75 ve Euribor + yüzde 1,45 olarak gerçekleşti. PEGASUS EKİMDE 4,21 MİLYON YOLCU TAŞIDI Pegasus Hava Taşımacılığı (PGSUS), Ekim 2026 trafik sonuçlarını açıkladı. Şirketin toplam yolcu sayısı geçen yılın aynı ayına göre yüzde 4 artarak 4,21 milyona yükseldi. İç hatlarda yolcu sayısı yüzde 14 artışla 1,55 milyona çıkarken, dış hatlarda yüzde 1 düşüşle 2,66 milyon oldu. Toplam doluluk oranı ise 0,5 puan gerileyerek yüzde 88,2 olarak gerçekleşti. Pegasus'un Ocak-Ekim dönemindeki toplam yolcu sayısı da yıllık yüzde 5 artışla 37,64 milyona ulaştı. AKSA ENERJİ'DEN GABON'DA 80 MW'LIK KAPASİTE ARTIŞI Aksa Enerji (AKSEN), Gabon Cumhuriyeti Elektrik Kurumu SEEG ile imzaladığı ek protokolle Libreville'deki elektrik santralinin kurulu gücünü 80 MW artırma kararı aldı. Daha önce 100 MW Libreville ve 45 MW Port Gentil olmak üzere toplam 145 MW kapasiteli santrallerin kurulması ve işletilmesi için anlaşma imzalayan şirket, yeni düzenlemeyle Libreville'deki toplam kapasiteyi 180 MW'a çıkaracak. Ek protokolle anlaşmanın süresi 10 yıldan 15 yıla uzatıldı. Mevcut 145 MW'lık santrallerin 2026 sonuna, ilave 80 MW'lık kapasitenin ise 2028 sonuna kadar devreye alınması planlanıyor. AYES ÇELİK'İN ALİAĞA FABRİKASINDA ÜRETİM BAŞLADI Ayes Çelik Hasır ve Çit Sanayi (AYES), yatırım sürecini tamamladığı Aliağa fabrikasında üretime başladığını duyurdu. Şirketin açıklamasına göre fabrikadaki kurulum, test ve devreye alma çalışmaları başarıyla tamamlandı. Böylece tesiste üretim faaliyetine geçildi. QUICK SİGORTA 10 AYLIK PRİM ÜRETİMİNİ AÇIKLADI Quick Sigorta (QUICK), 1 Ocak-31 Ekim 2026 dönemine ilişkin brüt yazılan prim üretimi bilgilerini Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda paylaştı. Şirketin açıklamasında ana sigorta branşları itibarıyla düzenlenen ve henüz denetimden geçmemiş prim üretimi verilerine yer verildi. Ancak paylaşılan metinde branş bazındaki prim tutarları bulunmuyor. KARDEMİR ÇELİK'TEN 14 MİLYON EUROLUK GES KREDİSİ Kardemir Çelik Sanayi (KARCL), Van ve Muş'ta gerçekleştireceği toplam 28,11 MWp kurulu gücündeki güneş enerjisi santrali yatırımları için 13 milyon 986 bin 926 avroluk kredi sözleşmesi imzaladı. DZ Bank AG Deutsche ile 5 Kasım 2026 tarihinde imzalanan sözleşme, Sinosure sigortası kapsamında gerçekleştirildi. Kredinin geri ödeme vadesi 9,5 yıl olarak belirlendi. Şirket, GES projelerinin sözleşme tarihinden itibaren yaklaşık 7 ay içinde tamamen devreye alınmasını bekliyor. Yatırımın enerji maliyetlerini düşürmesi ve kârlılığa katkı sağlaması hedefleniyor. HALKBANK, HALK KATILIM BANKASI'NI 14,8 MİLYAR TL'YE DEVRETTİ Halkbank (HALKB), sermayesinin yüzde 99,99'una sahip olduğu Halk Katılım Bankası'ndaki paylarının tamamını TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları A.Ş.'ye devretti. Devir işlemleri 10 Kasım 2026 itibarıyla tamamlandı. İşlemin toplam tutarı 14 milyar 799 milyon 999 bin 995,72 TL olarak açıklanırken, satış sonucunda 39 milyon 923 bin 999,72 TL kâr oluştu. Devir sonrasında Halkbank'ın Halk Katılım Bankası'ndaki iştirak oranı ve oy hakkı sıfıra indi. İşlem için BDDK izni 22 Ekim 2026 tarihinde alınmıştı.

articles.titleTr: Ziraat Bankası'nın 3.çeyrek net kârı 50,3 milyar TL'ye yükseldi: İşte bilanço detayları
articles.summaryTr: Ziraat Bankası, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 50,3 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Bankanın net faiz geliri yıllık bazda 85,5 milyar TL'den 123,4 milyar TL'ye, net ücret ve komisyon gelirleri ise 22,9 milyar TL'den 29,9 milyar TL'ye çıktı.
articles.articleText: Ziraat Bankası'nın 3.çeyrek net kârı 50,3 milyar TL'ye yükseldi: İşte bilanço detayları YAYIN TARİHİ, 10 Kasım 2026 20:07 PAYLAŞ - Ziraat Bankası, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 50,3 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Bankanın net faiz geliri yıllık bazda 85,5 milyar TL'den 123,4 milyar TL'ye, net ücret ve komisyon gelirleri ise 22,9 milyar TL'den 29,9 milyar TL'ye çıktı. Türkiye Cumhuriyeti Ziraat Bankası, 2026 yılının üçüncü çeyreğine ilişkin finansal sonuçlarını açıkladı. Bankanın net kârı, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 49,7 milyar TL seviyesinden 50,3 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. Net faiz geliri 123,4 milyar TL'ye çıktı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Ziraat Bankası'nın üçüncü çeyrekte elde ettiği net faiz geliri, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 85,5 milyar TL'den 123,4 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. Bankanın net ücret ve komisyon gelirleri de yıllık bazda artış gösterdi. Geçen yılın aynı döneminde 22,9 milyar TL olan gelir, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 29,9 milyar TL olarak gerçekleşti. Kredi hacmi 5,5 trilyon TL'ye ulaştı Ziraat Bankası'nın üçüncü çeyrek sonu itibarıyla toplam kredi hacmi 5,5 trilyon TL'ye yükseldi. Bankanın kredi büyüklüğü, 2025 yıl sonundaki 4,2 trilyon TL seviyesine kıyasla artış kaydetti.

articles.summary: The contents of the calendar, including hair clips and keychains, have been widely criticised on social media.

articles.titleTr: Kim Kardashian's Skims offers refunds for $148 advent calendar after backlash
articles.summaryTr: The contents of the calendar, including hair clips and keychains, have been widely criticised on social media.
articles.articleText: Kim Kardashian's Skims offers refunds for $148 advent calendar after backlash - Published Kim Kardashian's Skims is offering customers refunds for its $148 (£110) advent calendar which has been widely criticised on social media. The accessories advent calendar promised "twelve days of fun surprises" but has been mocked online for the quality of its contents, such as hair clips and keychains, with some comparing them to something you would find down the back of a sofa. A spokesperson for Skims has told a number of media outlets "for some, the calendar didn't meet expectations" and the company has "personally contacted every customer" to offer a full refund or credit to put towards other products". The BBC has contacted Skims for comment. The shapewear and clothing business was co-founded by Kardashian in 2019 and has made the reality TV star a billionaire, according to Forbes magazine. Skims was valued at $5bn in 2025 when it raised millions of dollars in new funding. One account on TikTok called spicychathouse compared the contents of the calendar to things "my cat collects from around my house". Another account said it looked like "a bunch of stuff that Kim Kardashian was emptying out of her bedside table". A number of accounts showed people cleaning out their own sofas and claiming they had accidentally created the Skims advent calendar. "It is really interesting to see this kind of backlash," said Kate Vlietstra, senior director of food and drink at market research analyst Mintel. "It is something we have been seeing a bit more in recent years, particularly with the trend for unboxing on social media," she said, "It means that, inevitably, if people are not feeling they're getting the value that they have hoped for from the advent calendar...they've purchased, then yes, there is going to be a backlash." Advent calendars remain popular, according to Helen Wing, head of innovation at market research company Ipsos though she said that "the buzz around them has reduced a little bit". She said according to Ipsos research, people are willing to pay a bit more for an advent calendar but the contents have to justify the price tag. Using a £285 advent calendar sold by Liberty as an example, Wing said the upmarket department story is "very open about the value of the contents". "They will say there is over £1,000 worth of content," she said. "If you've got that reassurance when you're making the purchase, particularly if it is for a gift, then it is important to have some faith that the contents are actually going to be worth the money that you're paying." articles.summaryTr: Peugeot, kasım ayında 9 modelinin güncel fiyatlarını ve kampanyalarını açıkladı. 3008'de 212 bin TL'ye varan fiyat avantajı sunulurken, 5008 GT'de 1 milyon TL'ye 12 ay vadeli yüzde 0,99 faizli kredi fırsatı öne çıkıyor.
articles.articleText: Peugeot Kasım 2026 kamanyaları açıklandı! İşte fiyatlar ve kredi kampanyaları Peugeot, kasım ayında 9 modelinin güncel fiyatlarını ve kampanyalarını açıkladı. 3008'de 212 bin TL'ye varan fiyat avantajı sunulurken, 5008 GT'de 1 milyon TL'ye 12 ay vadeli yüzde 0,99 faizli kredi fırsatı öne çıkıyor. PEUGEOT KASIM 2026 FİYATLARI VE KAMPANYALARI Peugeot, Kasım 2026 döneminde sıfır otomobil modellerinin güncel fiyatlarını ve finansman kampanyalarını duyurdu. Markanın SUV modelleri 2008, 3008 ve 5008'de dikkat çeken kredi seçenekleri sunulurken, 3008'in kampanyalı fiyatı 2 milyon 755 bin TL'ye geriledi. İşte Peugeot'nun kasım ayı fiyat listesi ve kampanyaları... PEUGEOT MODELLERİNİN KASIM 2026 FİYATLARI E-208 ALACAKLARA 300 BİN TL KREDİ VE NAKİT İNDİRİMİ Peugeot E-208 için kasım ayında iki farklı avantaj sunuluyor: - Kredi seçeneği: 300 bin TL, 12 ay vade, aylık yüzde 0,99 faiz. - Nakit indirimi: Kredi kullanmak istemeyenlere 20 bin TL indirim. PEUGEOT 2008'DE 800 BİN TL KREDİ FIRSATI Peugeot 2008 modelinde ticari müşterilere yönelik finansman kampanyası bulunuyor. - Kredi seçeneği: 800 bin TL, 6 ay vade, yüzde 1,99 faiz. - Nakit indirimi: Kredi kullanılmadığında 20 bin TL'ye varan indirim. PEUGEOT 3008'DE 212 BİN TL FİYAT AVANTAJI Peugeot 3008'in güncel fiyatı 2 milyon 967 bin TL olarak açıklanırken, kampanyalı fiyatı 2 milyon 755 bin TL'ye düşüyor. Böylece modelde 212 bin TL'lik fiyat farkı oluşuyor. - Kredi seçeneği: Koç Stellantis Finansman üzerinden 1 milyon TL, 6 ay vade, yüzde 1,99 faiz. PEUGEOT 5008'E 1 MİLYON TL KREDİ Peugeot 5008 için kasım ayında dikkat çeken bir finansman seçeneği sunuluyor. - Kredi seçeneği: 1 milyon TL, 12 ay vade, yüzde 0,99 faiz. - Geçerlilik: Kampanya 5008 GT versiyonu için geçerli.

news.summary: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.

news.titleTr: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
news.summaryTr: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.
news.articleText: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended. Crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin will resume deposits and withdrawals in Brazilian reais via Pix, the country’s instant payment system, next week, a company representative told Cointelegraph. The restart will come more than 15 days after an attack drained an estimated $49 million from wallets linked to the exchange. Customers will only be able to withdraw funds to accounts in their own name. Mercado Bitcoin will also credit customers’ accounts with proceeds from the settlement of fixed income products. Crypto deposits and withdrawals remain suspended, with no date set for their return. Mercado Bitcoin, one of Brazil’s largest crypto exchanges, began restoring access on Monday, a week after the attack, by allowing customers to view their accounts in read-only mode. Customers who regain access are directed to a page detailing the exchange’s security measures and regular audits since 2018, with a link to a separate account of the incident. Fabricio Tota, Mercado Bitcoin’s vice president of new business, outlined the next phase in a recent video. The exchange has yet to publish a rollout schedule on its website. “The resumption will proceed gradually, and the rollout of additional services will be communicated to clients in advance through MB’s official channels,” the representative said. The Nov. 2 attack on Mercado Bitcoin came four days after hackers stole about $6.3 billion in crypto from Binance’s hot wallets in a separate breach. The FBI attributed the Binance theft to North Korean hackers. The crypto exchange said it would cover the losses using its emergency fund and corporate treasury. news.title: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned
news.summary: The ruling brings to an end an 11-year legal battle by dual-citizen Jason Jones.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned
news.summaryTr: The ruling brings to an end an 11-year legal battle by dual-citizen Jason Jones.
news.articleText: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned - Published A UK court has overturned laws criminalising same-sex intimacy in Trinidad and Tobago. London's Judicial Committee of the Privy Council (JCPC), the Caribbean island's final court of appeal, ruled the laws were not in keeping with the "fundamental individual right to respect for private and family life." The judgement is the result of an 11-year legal battle brought by dual-citizen Jason Jones, 62, who said he hoped it would "accelerate the fight for full equality." Jones had successfully challenged the laws in 2018 in Trinidad's High Court, however the ruling was overturned on appeal by the Trinidadian government. It is the first time the JCPC has ever decided on a case to decriminalise same-sex intimacy, and campaigners hope it will spark similar successful legal challenges elsewhere in the Commonwealth. Prior to this historic decision, Trinidad and Tobago was one of some 34 Commonwealth countries continuing to criminalise homosexuality based on colonial-era British laws. Under these laws, consensual same-sex intimacy is punishable by imprisonment, and in some cases carries the death penalty. The Attorney General of Trinidad and Tobago had argued that the law was protected from legal challenges by the "savings law clauses" - which carried over existing British laws into newly independent states. Representatives for Jones argued that the laws violated an individual's right to privacy and argued the government's changes to the laws in 1986 - which saw stricter punishments introduced - meant the savings clause protections no longer applied. The judicial committee unanimously found in favour of Jones. Handing down the judgement, Lord Sales told the court the laws "cannot be regarded as reasonably justifiable in a society that has a proper respect for the rights and freedoms of an individual". Jones, human rights campaigner and appellant in the appeal, said: "These laws never reflected who we are as a people and a nation - diverse, multiracial, and secular. "They told LGBTQ+ people that we were criminals in our own country. That message ends today." Lawyer Anand Ramlogan SC, representing Jones, said the judgement was a "landmark victory for gay rights, equal dignity and respect for private and family life in Trinidad and Tobago." news.title: US federal authorities could have prevented Epstein crimes, report finds
news.summary: The report by a Republican-led congressional committee follows a 15-month investigation into the handling of the late disgraced financier's case.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: US federal authorities could have prevented Epstein crimes, report finds
news.summaryTr: The report by a Republican-led congressional committee follows a 15-month investigation into the handling of the late disgraced financier's case.
news.articleText: US federal authorities could have prevented Epstein crimes, report finds - Published Crimes committed by the late disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein after 2005 could have been prevented were it not for "failures" by federal investigators and prosecutors, a congressional investigation has concluded. The Republican-led US House Oversight Committee on Tuesday released its final report into what it described as the "decades-long" mishandling of the criminal investigations into Epstein and his long-term associate Ghislaine Maxwell. The report's findings are based on interviews and depositions with witnesses, government files, and financial records over a 15-month period. Epstein died in 2019 as he awaited trial on sex trafficking charges. "While some of these failures involved an exercise in poor judgement by the USAO, others appeared to be the result of Epstein's pervasive and wide-reaching influence," the report reads, referring to the US Attorney's Office. It states that, rather than fully investigating allegations in other states, the USAO for the Southern District of Florida entered an agreement with Epstein in 2007 allowing him to evade federal prosecution. Regarding Epstein's death in a New York prison, investigators concluded this was a result of "a series of institutional failures at the facility," which included staffing shortages, overworked employees, poor recordkeeping, and lax security practices. Testimony the panel solicited was "unable to definitively dispel certain theories" surrounding Epstein's death, the report states, including accounting for a lapse in surveillance footage. It found the justice department (DoJ) failed to communicate about document releases and that deficient redactions exposed survivors' sensitive personal information. Earlier this year, the DoJ had to remove thousands of documents related to Epstein from its website after victims said their identities had been compromised. The report also alleges that financial institutions like American Express enabled human trafficking and immigration fraud, by allowing Epstein to use decoy flights and dummy itineraries to transport foreign workers across borders. The BBC has contacted American Express for comment. The investigative panel recommended that Congress should pass legislation to prevent the weaponisation of non-disclosure agreements, which they said Epstein used to silence survivors. "Epstein operated with impunity, shielded and enabled by powerful connections and a justice system that repeatedly failed his victims," said James Comer, the Republican chairman of the committee. He called upon the DoJ to "interview or re-interview key witnesses, investigate Epstein associates accused of criminal activity, and ensure survivors have access to their records. The report accuses Democrats of being "obsessed" with trying to implicate US President Donald Trump and that an "unfounded witch hunt continued without regard for the interests of survivors". Trump has previously said he was friendly with Epstein before they fell out in 2004. The president's name has appeared thousands of times in the Epstein files but there is no suggestion that appearing in the documents implies any wrongdoing. The committee's review of documents did not identify any that would implicate Trump, the report concluded. In a statement, Rep Robert Garcia, the top Democrat on the Oversight Committee, alleged his Republican colleagues "released a report based on an incomplete investigation and zero public hearings on Jeffrey Epstein". Garcia accused the justice department of withholding "over 2.5 million pages of documents". "We will not allow the President and his allies to dismiss this investigation," said Garcia, who is expected to lead the committee when Democrats take control of Congress in January following the recent midterm elections. - Published23 April

news.summary: The AI company behind the Claude chatbot will offer its shares at between $70 and $78, which is lower than what was expected.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Anthropic set for $1.3tn stock market debut despite 'catastrophic' AI warning
news.summaryTr: The AI company behind the Claude chatbot will offer its shares at between $70 and $78, which is lower than what was expected.
news.articleText: Anthropic set for $1.3tn stock market debut despite 'catastrophic' AI warning - Published Anthropic, the artificial intelligence (AI) company behind the Claude chatbot, could be valued at around $1.3 trillion (£1 trillion) when it lists its shares for sale on New York's Nasdaq stock exchange. The loss-making company says it will offer its shares for between $70 and $78 each and will raise up to $64bn when it floats this month. It would value Anthropic at between $1.1tn and $1.3tn which, although large, is below the $2tn some backers of the firm predicted in summer, according to the Financial Times. The huge valuation comes despite the company warning last month that AI could pose "catastrophic or existential risks to humanity". It is floating at a volatile time for big tech firms. After last week's US midterm elections, the Nasdaq fell sharply on concerns a Democrat-led Congress could slow development of AI and the buildout of data centres. There are also wider fears over the billions of dollars being spent on AI and whether it will pay off. In its most recent results for the six months to the end of June, Anthropic's revenues jumped to $16.2bn from $1.1bn in the same period last year. However, its pre-tax loss jumped to $80.7bn from $12.9bn. Fiona Cincotta, a senior market analyst at City Index, said the $64bn Anthropic wants to raise is "fairly bullish" within "the volatility [and] concerns towards AI that we've seen in sort of particularly last week". She told Reuters: "It's showing that they are still sort of upbeat about the outlook as far as AI is concerned and that obviously that they think that the demand is going to be there." Anthropic, which will list under the symbol ANT on 19 November, will be the first fully AI-focused company to go public, making it a test case for the future of the technology. At $1.3tn, Anthropic's possible valuation is below SpaceX, Elon Musk's rocket, satellite and artificial intelligence company, which listed its shares in June and was valued at nearly $1.8tn. - Global stocks plunge as fears over US AI slowdown spread to Asia and Europe - Published4 days ago - Anthropic's blockbuster share listing - 5 surprising things we now know - Published26 October Anthropic is just five years old. It was co-founded in 2021 by brother and sister Dario and Daniela Amodei along with five others – all of whom worked at OpenAI, the rival AI giant behind ChatGPT. It announced its intention to list on the stock market in June and OpenAI followed suit. That listing is now expected to occur early next year. The listing announcements were followed by a series of incidents involving AI agents, which are bots designed to operate somewhat autonomously, going rogue. Current and former staff of both companies have warned AI technology was being developed without the ability to protect humanity from possible future harms enacted by AI. Anthropic has admitted that advanced AI systems "could, if not developed, deployed, and operated with appropriate safeguards, oversight, and security measures, pose catastrophic or existential risks to humanity, particularly if such systems were misused, replicated, weaponised, or allowed to operate with a high degree of autonomy". The company has reiterated promises to develop AI to be beneficial to people. It has warned investors its future success depends largely on its ability to develop the most advanced AI models, and that "any failure to do so could adversely affect our business".

news.titleTr: Tüm hisseler devredildi: İki kamu bankası TVF çatısı altında buluştu
news.summaryTr: Türkiye Varlık Fonu, Ziraat Katılım ve Halk Katılım bankalarının tüm hisselerini TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları AŞ'ye devretti. İşlemlerin tamamlanmasıyla iki kamu sermayeli katılım bankası aynı çatı altında toplandı.
news.articleText: Tüm hisseler devredildi: İki kamu bankası TVF çatısı altında buluştu - Türkiye Varlık Fonu, Ziraat Katılım ve Halk Katılım bankalarının tüm hisselerini TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları AŞ'ye devretti. İşlemlerin tamamlanmasıyla iki kamu sermayeli katılım bankası aynı çatı altında toplandı. Türkiye Varlık Fonu (TVF), Ziraat Katılım ve Halk Katılım bankalarının paylarının tamamının TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları AŞ'ye devredildiğini duyurdu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle TVF'nin internet sitesinden yapılan açıklamaya göre, 7 Ekim 2026 tarihinde duyurulan pay devir sözleşmeleri kapsamında ilgili yasal ve düzenleyici süreçler tamamlandı. Devir işlemlerinin kapanışı da gerçekleştirildi. Kamu sermayeli katılım bankaları tek çatı altında Devir işlemiyle kamu sermayeli katılım finans kurumlarının aynı çatı altında toplanmasına yönelik süreçte önemli bir aşama tamamlanmış oldu. Düzenlemeyle katılım finans kurumlarının kapasitesinin ve rekabet gücünün artırılması, finansal piyasalar içerisindeki paylarının büyütülmesi hedefleniyor. TVF'den katılım finans ekosistemi vurgusu Türkiye Varlık Fonu, yatırım stratejisi doğrultusunda finansal piyasaların derinleşmesine ve katılım finans ekosisteminin gelişmesine katkı sağlamaya yönelik çalışmalarını sürdüreceğini bildirdi.

news.title: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
news.summary: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
news.summaryTr: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.
news.articleText: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors. Crypto industry experts warned on Tuesday that higher-than-expected US inflation could lead to a another Federal Reserve interest rate hike, making borrowing more expensive and potentially discouraging investment in cryptocurrencies. The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.4% month over month in October, above economists’ forecast of 0.3%, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics - a slower increase than September’s 0.6% rise. Core inflation, which excludes food and energy prices, rose 0.3%, above the expected 0.2%. Currently, the Federal Reserve holds its benchmark interest rate at 3.75% to 4.00%, after raising it by a quarter-point in September and leaving it unchanged in October. The report came just a few hours after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said in London that another core inflation reading of 0.3% or higher could prompt the Fed to consider a larger interest rate hike in December. “In that case, I believe a 50-basis-point hike in the policy rate should be considered at the December meeting,” Waller said. “Hiking only 25-basis-points would put our credibility at risk, a risk I am not eager to take.” Markets were already pricing a quarter-point Fed hike in December. Tuesday’s data and Waller’s remarks are now raising the odds that the Fed would tighten monetary policy more aggressively in December, potentially raising borrowing costs and squeezing returns for leveraged crypto investors. Related: US midterm elections 2026 as it happened: Democrats win control of Congress Crypto experts warn of higher borrowing costs After the CPI release, traders were pricing in slightly more than a quarter point of Fed tightening for December, according to Jeff Anderson, head of US at crypto trading firm STS Digital. “Following today’s CPI release, markets are now pricing approximately 27 basis points of tightening into the December rate curve,” Anderson said in comments shared with Cointelegraph. “The prospect of another rate hike is becoming increasingly difficult to ignore.” CME FedWatch data as of 16:28 UTC on Tuesday showed an 88.3% chance of a quarter-point rate hike in December and an 11.7% chance of a half-point increase. Meanwhile, the broader crypto market was trading lower following the report, with total market capitalization falling 1.6% over the past 24 hours to $2.57 trillion, according to CoinGecko. Bitcoin (BTC) traded near $73,274, down 2% over the past 24 hours, while Ether (ETH) fell nearly 5% to around $2,028 and Solana (SOL) dropped 5.6% to $82. Experts said that higher interest rates could also reduce profits from some crypto investments. Adam Haeems, head of asset management at Tesseract Group, told Cointelegraph that investors who borrow money to make other investments could earn less if borrowing becomes more expensive. “Carry strategies earn the gap between what their assets yield and what they pay to borrow, so they are squeezed when borrowing costs rise relative to that yield,” Haeems said. “Over the past two weeks the rate paid to USDC lenders on Aave’s main market ranged from about 3.2% to 7%, while three-month Treasury yields stayed close to 4.2%.” The difference, in turn, could influence where investors put their money, especially if traditional investments offer better returns with less risk. Inflation adds to pressure after US midterms The inflation report also came a week after the US midterm elections, in which Democrats won control of both the House and Senate. “There is also likely to be growing political pressure from a blue Congress to bring inflation under control, potentially reinforcing the case for higher rates,” Anderson said. Still, he added that he remained skeptical about whether further rate hikes would address the underlying causes of inflation. While Congress does not set interest rates, lawmakers can influence economic policy and crypto regulation. For instance, the CLARITY Act, a bill aimed at creating clearer crypto rules for the US, has been stalled since January amid disagreements between Democrats and Republicans. The shift in congressional power combined with the possibility of higher borrowing costs could create even more uncertainty for crypto investors, experts said. news.title: First day of Ukraine peace talks constructive, Zelensky says
news.summary: Delegations from Kyiv, Washington and Moscow are in the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: First day of Ukraine peace talks constructive, Zelensky says
news.summaryTr: Delegations from Kyiv, Washington and Moscow are in the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.
news.articleText: First day of Ukraine peace talks constructive, Zelensky says - Published The first of two days of trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia and the US aimed at ending the war in Ukraine has concluded in Abu Dhabi. While senior officials from Kyiv and Moscow were tight-lipped after the four hour-long discussions, President Volodymyr Zelensky, who was not at the talks, said they had proved "constructive and quite substantive". Speaking from Paris, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio also said the meeting had been "very productive". Although expectations for a breakthrough that ends Russia's full-scale war on Ukraine are low, US officials said earlier that Moscow and Kyiv were privately showing "a little bit of flexibility" on the issue of who would control Ukraine's eastern regions in a postwar scenario. Zelensky also said that humanitarian issues such as prisoner of war exchanges had been discussed. At the start of Tuesday's talks President Donald Trump's son-in-law, Jared Kushner, told delegates that the US had "narrowed the gaps" between the two sides, without providing details, and hoped to move towards a "solution that hopefully ends the war". Kushner had said earlier the talks would be focused on addressing the "postwar security concerns" of both Russia and Ukraine. He and Trump peace envoy Steve Witkoff also met Ukrainian and European and Nato officials on the sidelines of the main meeting. Until now European leaders have largely been excluded from peace talks, but they have pushed to be included in the discussions amid concerns that decisions about their continent's security would be made without them. The Americans appear to support this, with Rubio acknowledging during a visit to Paris that the Europeans "are a part of solving this problem for the long term". However, "the Russians have a bad taste in their mouth with the Europeans", according to a US official. Some proposals favoured by EU officials - such as calling an unconditional ceasefire as a prerequisite for peace negotiations - are routinely rejected by Moscow. Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said on Tuesday that a truce would just allow Kyiv to regroup. "We will not agree to it," he said. Moscow and Kyiv's positions are still far apart on ending the conflict. A key area of disagreement involves Ukraine's eastern region of Donetsk, which is mostly occupied by Russia. Moscow has demanded that Ukraine relinquish the parts of Donetsk it still holds, while Kyiv wants to freeze the contact line to maintain control over those areas, which it says are crucial to its future security. While neither side has budged on these demands, the US official speaking on the eve of the talks suggested that this was just the public stance and that Moscow and Kyiv had shown "a little bit of flexibility, privately". However, he acknowledged the issue would not be solved without discussions about a new "security architecture". "They will not solve the Donetsk issue and the territorial issue until they know what the security architecture is going to be after the war," the official said. "And keep in mind, we're not going to be able to finalise one without the other." For Ukraine, a post-war "security architecture" may include reassurance that allies will come to its aid if it comes under attack again. For Russia, that could be its longstanding ambition to see Nato roll back from Eastern Europe – which would be alarming to Europeans. The framework being proposed includes security consultations and crisis communications hotlines, as well as "reciprocal de-escalation measures" between the two. The officials also floated the re-activation of the Nato-Russia Council that has been largely paused since 2022. The last round of trilateral talks, held in Geneva in February, ended without a breakthrough. Soon after, the US-Israel war on Iran diverted Washington's attention from Ukraine, and no other discussions were held since. From the start of his second term in office, US President Donald Trump – who once boasted he could end the war in Ukraine within a day – has spearheaded several rounds of talks to end the conflict, albeit with little success. Meanwhile, his increasingly conciliatory approach towards Moscow has fuelled deep unease in Kyiv and across the European Union. After meeting Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev in Washington last week, Trump touted a forthcoming "big, beautiful agreement" on Ukraine that "might involve all of Europe". Many in Ukraine are sceptical that this would result in a fair peace. Ukrainian MP Oleksandr Merezhko, head of the foreign affairs parliamentary committee, told the BBC he believed Trump wanted "a quick deal at the expense of Ukraine", which will certainly be rejected by Kyiv. The only way to make Russia's Vladimir Putin start real negotiations was by putting greater pressure on Russia through sanctions and deep strikes, Merezhko said. "While Putin has a war machine up and running, he has no incentives to negotiate." He also mentioned recent moves by Trump, such as his deal to buy diesel from Russia, as something that "only encourages Moscow to continue the war". Moscow's delegation in Abu Dhabi includes Kremlin aide Vladimir Medinsky, deputy foreign ministers Sergei Ryabkov and Mikhail Galuzin, spy chief Igor Kostyukov and army general Yury Zhigarlovsky. Kyiv has sent several senior officials who have been part of previous negotiating teams, including Foreign Intelligence Service head Rustem Umerov, Volodymyr Zelensky's chief of staff Kyrylo Budanov, and MP Davyd Arakhamiya. Away from Abu Dhabi, Russia continues to pummel Ukraine with deadly bombardments and strikes on energy infrastructure, viewed in Kyiv as proof that Moscow wants to corner Ukraine into accepting a deal on Russia's terms. On Monday, Kushner was cautious to point out that the Abu Dhabi talks could at most "build momentum toward the next phase of negotiations". "This is an extraordinarily difficult and complicated conflict," he wrote on X, adding the US was "approaching these discussions with determination and realism." İşte detaylar - Yapı Kredi, uluslararası piyasalardan yaklaşık 933 milyon dolar tutarında sendikasyon kredisi sağladı. 18 ülkeden 40 finansal kurumun katıldığı anlaşma, 367 ve 734 gün vadeli dört ayrı dilimden oluştu. Yapı ve Kredi Bankası, yılın ikinci yarısında uluslararası piyasalardan yaklaşık 933 milyon dolar tutarında sendikasyon kredisi sağladı. Bankadan yapılan açıklamaya göre anlaşmaya 18 ülkeden 40 finansal kurum katıldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 367 ve 734 gün vadeli dört ayrı dilimden oluşan kredinin ortak koordinatörlüğünü Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank, Bank of America, Emirates NBD ve Standard Chartered üstlendi. İşlemin aracılığını ise Emirates NBD gerçekleştirdi. Kredinin detayları belli oldu Sendikasyon kredisi kapsamında 367 gün vadeli 349 milyon dolar ve 356,5 milyon avro, 734 gün vadeli ise 97 milyon dolar ve 77 milyon avro finansman sağlandı. Kredinin maliyeti vade ve para birimine göre farklılık gösterdi. Buna göre 367 gün vadeli dilimlerde dolar için SOFR + yüzde 1,25, avro için Euribor + yüzde 1,00 maliyet belirlendi. 734 gün vadeli dilimlerde ise dolar maliyeti SOFR + yüzde 1,75, avro maliyeti Euribor + yüzde 1,45 oldu. Erün: Türkiye ekonomisine duyulan güvenin göstergesi Yapı Kredi Üst Yöneticisi (CEO) Gökhan Erün, uluslararası piyasalardan sağlanan kaynağın bankanın finansal yapısına ve Türkiye ekonomisine duyulan güveni gösterdiğini belirtti. Erün, yaklaşık 933 milyon dolarlık işlemin uluslararası finans kuruluşlarıyla kurulan uzun soluklu ilişkilerin bir yansıması olduğunu ifade etti. Uluslararası kuruluşların ilgisinin arkasında bankanın sağlam bilanço yapısı, etkin risk yönetimi ve sürdürülebilir büyüme anlayışının bulunduğunu vurgulayan Erün, gelecek dönemde kaynak çeşitliliğini artırmaya ve reel sektörün finansman ihtiyaçlarını desteklemeye devam edeceklerini kaydetti.

news.articleText: Borsa İstanbul’da 7 şirketten KAP açıklaması: Milyarlık anlaşmalar ve yeni yatırımlar Borsa İstanbul'da 7 şirketten yeni iş, yatırım ve finansman açıklaması geldi. Yapı Kredi 933 milyon dolarlık kredi sağlarken, Aksa Enerji Gabon'da kapasite artırdı. Kardemir Çelik GES kredisi aldı, Halkbank 14,8 milyar TL'lik devri tamamladı. YAPI KREDİ'DEN 933 MİLYON DOLARLIK SENDİKASYON KREDİSİ Yapı ve Kredi Bankası (YKBNK), 18 ülkeden 40 finansal kurumun katılımıyla yaklaşık 933 milyon dolar tutarında sendikasyon kredisi anlaşması imzaladı. Dört ayrı dilimden oluşan kredinin 367 gün vadeli kısmında 349 milyon dolar ve 356,5 milyon avro, 734 gün vadeli kısmında ise 97 milyon dolar ve 77 milyon avro finansman sağlandı. 367 gün vadeli dolar ve avro dilimlerinin maliyeti sırasıyla SOFR + yüzde 1,25 ve Euribor + yüzde 1 olurken, 734 gün vadeli dilimlerde maliyet SOFR + yüzde 1,75 ve Euribor + yüzde 1,45 olarak gerçekleşti. PEGASUS EKİMDE 4,21 MİLYON YOLCU TAŞIDI Pegasus Hava Taşımacılığı (PGSUS), Ekim 2026 trafik sonuçlarını açıkladı. Şirketin toplam yolcu sayısı geçen yılın aynı ayına göre yüzde 4 artarak 4,21 milyona yükseldi. İç hatlarda yolcu sayısı yüzde 14 artışla 1,55 milyona çıkarken, dış hatlarda yüzde 1 düşüşle 2,66 milyon oldu. Toplam doluluk oranı ise 0,5 puan gerileyerek yüzde 88,2 olarak gerçekleşti. Pegasus'un Ocak-Ekim dönemindeki toplam yolcu sayısı da yıllık yüzde 5 artışla 37,64 milyona ulaştı. AKSA ENERJİ'DEN GABON'DA 80 MW'LIK KAPASİTE ARTIŞI Aksa Enerji (AKSEN), Gabon Cumhuriyeti Elektrik Kurumu SEEG ile imzaladığı ek protokolle Libreville'deki elektrik santralinin kurulu gücünü 80 MW artırma kararı aldı. Daha önce 100 MW Libreville ve 45 MW Port Gentil olmak üzere toplam 145 MW kapasiteli santrallerin kurulması ve işletilmesi için anlaşma imzalayan şirket, yeni düzenlemeyle Libreville'deki toplam kapasiteyi 180 MW'a çıkaracak. Ek protokolle anlaşmanın süresi 10 yıldan 15 yıla uzatıldı. Mevcut 145 MW'lık santrallerin 2026 sonuna, ilave 80 MW'lık kapasitenin ise 2028 sonuna kadar devreye alınması planlanıyor. AYES ÇELİK'İN ALİAĞA FABRİKASINDA ÜRETİM BAŞLADI Ayes Çelik Hasır ve Çit Sanayi (AYES), yatırım sürecini tamamladığı Aliağa fabrikasında üretime başladığını duyurdu. Şirketin açıklamasına göre fabrikadaki kurulum, test ve devreye alma çalışmaları başarıyla tamamlandı. Böylece tesiste üretim faaliyetine geçildi. QUICK SİGORTA 10 AYLIK PRİM ÜRETİMİNİ AÇIKLADI Quick Sigorta (QUICK), 1 Ocak-31 Ekim 2026 dönemine ilişkin brüt yazılan prim üretimi bilgilerini Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda paylaştı. Şirketin açıklamasında ana sigorta branşları itibarıyla düzenlenen ve henüz denetimden geçmemiş prim üretimi verilerine yer verildi. Ancak paylaşılan metinde branş bazındaki prim tutarları bulunmuyor. KARDEMİR ÇELİK'TEN 14 MİLYON EUROLUK GES KREDİSİ Kardemir Çelik Sanayi (KARCL), Van ve Muş'ta gerçekleştireceği toplam 28,11 MWp kurulu gücündeki güneş enerjisi santrali yatırımları için 13 milyon 986 bin 926 avroluk kredi sözleşmesi imzaladı. DZ Bank AG Deutsche ile 5 Kasım 2026 tarihinde imzalanan sözleşme, Sinosure sigortası kapsamında gerçekleştirildi. Kredinin geri ödeme vadesi 9,5 yıl olarak belirlendi. Şirket, GES projelerinin sözleşme tarihinden itibaren yaklaşık 7 ay içinde tamamen devreye alınmasını bekliyor. Yatırımın enerji maliyetlerini düşürmesi ve kârlılığa katkı sağlaması hedefleniyor. HALKBANK, HALK KATILIM BANKASI'NI 14,8 MİLYAR TL'YE DEVRETTİ Halkbank (HALKB), sermayesinin yüzde 99,99'una sahip olduğu Halk Katılım Bankası'ndaki paylarının tamamını TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları A.Ş.'ye devretti. Devir işlemleri 10 Kasım 2026 itibarıyla tamamlandı. İşlemin toplam tutarı 14 milyar 799 milyon 999 bin 995,72 TL olarak açıklanırken, satış sonucunda 39 milyon 923 bin 999,72 TL kâr oluştu. Devir sonrasında Halkbank'ın Halk Katılım Bankası'ndaki iştirak oranı ve oy hakkı sıfıra indi. İşlem için BDDK izni 22 Ekim 2026 tarihinde alınmıştı.

news.titleTr: Ziraat Bankası'nın 3.çeyrek net kârı 50,3 milyar TL'ye yükseldi: İşte bilanço detayları
news.summaryTr: Ziraat Bankası, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 50,3 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Bankanın net faiz geliri yıllık bazda 85,5 milyar TL'den 123,4 milyar TL'ye, net ücret ve komisyon gelirleri ise 22,9 milyar TL'den 29,9 milyar TL'ye çıktı.
news.articleText: Ziraat Bankası'nın 3.çeyrek net kârı 50,3 milyar TL'ye yükseldi: İşte bilanço detayları YAYIN TARİHİ, 10 Kasım 2026 20:07 PAYLAŞ - Ziraat Bankası, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 50,3 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Bankanın net faiz geliri yıllık bazda 85,5 milyar TL'den 123,4 milyar TL'ye, net ücret ve komisyon gelirleri ise 22,9 milyar TL'den 29,9 milyar TL'ye çıktı. Türkiye Cumhuriyeti Ziraat Bankası, 2026 yılının üçüncü çeyreğine ilişkin finansal sonuçlarını açıkladı. Bankanın net kârı, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 49,7 milyar TL seviyesinden 50,3 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. Net faiz geliri 123,4 milyar TL'ye çıktı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Ziraat Bankası'nın üçüncü çeyrekte elde ettiği net faiz geliri, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 85,5 milyar TL'den 123,4 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. Bankanın net ücret ve komisyon gelirleri de yıllık bazda artış gösterdi. Geçen yılın aynı döneminde 22,9 milyar TL olan gelir, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 29,9 milyar TL olarak gerçekleşti.
